name: How does AEO differ from traditional SEO for insurance agents?
description: AEO extends traditional SEO by optimizing for AI-driven engines, focusing on natural language understanding and user intent beyond just keywords.

mainEntity.name: How does AEO differ from traditional SEO for insurance agents?

acceptedAnswer.text: While traditional SEO focuses on optimizing for keyword rankings and search engine algorithms, AEO expands this to include optimization for AI-driven engines and their evolving understanding of user intent. AEO emphasizes natural language processing, semantic search, and the context of user queries, rather than just keywords. For insurance agents, this means structuring content to answer complex questions comprehensively, providing clear and concise information, and ensuring that their digital footprint is easily digestible by AI. AEO is a forward-looking approach that prepares an agent's online presence for the increasing prevalence of AI in how consumers find information and make decisions.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO extends traditional SEO by optimizing for AI-driven engines, focusing on natural language understanding and user intent beyond just keywords.
